name: Caorunn Gin

Masterfully made with quinine since 1783. A timeless classic, Perfect mixed with Gordon's®.

With Sweetener

name: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 1L
flavour_style: balanced, bright, fresh and citrus-forward taste
description: In its iconic blue bottle, Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin features 10 hand selected botanicals from around the world, creating a balanced, bright, fresh and citrus-forward taste. Perfect for classic gin cocktails like a Gin & Tonic or Sapphire Negroni.

name: Fever-Tree Light Mediterranean Tonic
description: If 3/4 of your drink is the mixer, mix with the best.

name: Fever-Tree Refreshingly Light Indian Tonic Water
description: By blending luscious botanical oils with spring water and quinine of the highest quality from the 'fever trees' from the eastern hill ranges of the Democratic Republic of Congo, we have created a delicious, award-winning tonic water.

name: Fever-Tree Premium Indian Tonic Water
description: Our Premium Indian Tonic water uses a handful of different botanicals, including our distinctive quinine and oils from Mexican Bitter Oranges, to give a uniquely clean and refreshing taste and aroma.

name: Gordon's Alcohol Free Spirit with Distilled Botanicals 0% vol
description: Gordon's 0.0% Alcohol Free Spirit provides the bold, piney juniper-led taste you'd expect from Gordon's, but without the alcohol. It delivers a truly authentic and vibrant non-alcoholic experience that captures the spirit of the range perfectly. Recommended for your mocktails and as the perfect alcohol-free alternative to your usual gin and tonic.

name: Hendrick's Gin (Abv 41.4%)   70cl
flavour_style: smooth with subtle flavours rose petal and cucumber essence
description:
- No other Gin tastes like Hendrick’s because no other Gin is made like Hendrick’s. Smooth, with a balance of subtle flavours, Hendrick's Gin is a deliciously refreshing infusion of rose petal and cucumber essence.
- Perfectly delectable whether neat or mixed, Hendrick’s Original Gin, with its signature cucumber garnish, is a refreshingly exquisite addition to any summer garden party or BBQ that will have your guests coming back for more.
- Elevate any Gin cocktail and special summer night with Hendrick’s Gin – opt for a refreshingly curious Hendrick’s Cucumber Lemonade or release your inner mixologist and shake up a Hendrick’s Martini, or sip a delightful Hendrick’s Negroni.
- Hendrick’s Gin is an exquisite gift for any drinker and any occasion, the bold vintage design elevates the at-home entertaining experience for any Gin lover, cocktail expert, or at-home bartenders alike.
- For a taste of summer in every sip, concoct the classic Hendrick’s and Tonic – a simple, yet elegant, drink perfect for any summer gathering. Simply serve Hendrick's over ice with tonic water and garnish with thinly sliced cucumber.

Experience the unique infusion of rose and cucumber with Hendrick’s Gin. This balance of distinctive yet subtle flavours adds a remarkable twist to the quintessential gin and tonic. Why settle for ordinary when you can have deliciously unusual?

Crafting gin cocktails
The floral fragrance and smooth taste of Hendrick’s Gin makes it ideal for cocktails that can be as classic or creative as the occasion demands. Raise the bar of elegance with original gin cocktails at drinks parties and garden get-togethers. Or serve in a refreshing gin and tonics to accompany low-key nights in.

Perfectly presentable for gifting
Wondrously versatile, Hendrick’s Gin is as cracking at Christmas as it is sublime in summer. Dressed up in a striking black bottle with an apothecary-inspired look, this premium spirit transforms a drinks cabinet from purely practical to delightfully decorative – the perfect gin gift.

How the gin is made
No other gin tastes like Hendrick’s because no other gin is made like Hendrick’s. Handcrafted in Scotland by award-winning distillers William Grant & Sons, the excellent quality and unusual taste of Hendrick’s Gin is fiercely protected.
- Hendrick’s is a divine marriage of two different spirits from two utterly dissimilar types of stills: the Bennet Still and our rare Carter-head Still.
- Combining these two spirits with marvellous infusion of rose and cucumber yields an extraordinarily smooth gin that is a rare union of lightness and complexity. Award

In 2018, the Hendrick's Master Distiller, Lesley Gracie was named Distiller of the Year 2018 by Gin Magazine

Produced by family owned distillers, William Grant & Sons, named Distiller of the Year at the International Wine & Spirits Competition 2018 and the International Spirits Challenge 2018.

name: Gordon's Premium Pink Spirit Drink
description: Gordon's Premium Pink is a vibrant gin crafted with the perfect balance of natural botanicals and distilled fruit essences. Infused with the flavour of raspberries, strawberries and redcurrants, this gin boasts a pink hue and a refreshing fruity flavour profile. Gordon's Premium Pink provides a light and refreshing tasting drink that makes the perfect gift for gin lovers or simply to enjoy with friends. The spirit balances the crisp, juniper taste of Gordon's with the sweetness of raspberries and strawberries and a tang of redcurrant. Inspired by an original 1880 recipe from Alexander Gordon, Premium Pink is carefully crafted using the highest quality ingredients.

name: Whitley Neill Rhubarb & Ginger Gin
description: Inspired by the glory of the English country garden. Essence of rhubarb adds a tart crisp edge whilst the real ginger warms the palate.

name: Fever-Tree Light Aromatic Tonic
description: By blending the gentle bitterness of South American angostura bark with aromatic botanicals, such as cardamom, pimento berry and ginger, we've created a delicious, unique tonic water that can be enjoyed with gin to make a Pink G&T or as a sophisticated soft drink on its own.

name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin 70CL
description: Tanqueray London Dry is a perfectly balanced gin, delivering the ideal combination of four classic gin botanicals: refreshing juniper, peppery coriander, aromatic angelica and sweet liquorice. Created by Charles Tanqueray in 1830, Tanqueray London Dry Gin is still made according to the original timeless recipe. This award-winning and iconic spirit, distilled four times, is best enjoyed with a premium tonic water of your choice, plenty of ice and a wedge of lime, although it also makes a great base for a variety of cocktails.

name: Whitley Neill Blood Orange Gin
description: Inspired by the vibrant flavours of Sicily. Extract of sanguine Sicilian blood oranges injects a dynamic citrus burst to the clean gin base.

name: Whitley Neill Handcrafted Dry Raspberry Gin
description: Bright flavours from Scottish raspberries, balanced with juniper notes. A delicate sweetness rounds this deliciously vibrant gin.

name: Whitley Neill Distillers Cut London Dry Gin   70cl
description: Strong Juniper and citrus fruits, hints of orange, angelica root, liquorice and coriander to form a complex Dry Gin.

name: Whitley Neill Black Cherry Gin
description:
Black Cherry Gin
Inspired by South African cherry orchards, this delicious gin is infused with succulent black cherries for a deep and luscious flavour.
Johnny Neill

name: Brecon Botanicals Gin   70cl
description:
The nose is a rich complex of fresh juniper. Followed quickly with coriander and a complexity of gin flavours. Hints of citrus mingle with oriental spices. On adding a mixer the citrus, lemon, orange and even bergamot open out as well as hints of cinnamon, clove and even saffron.

Medium length on the finish leaving you ready for the next mouthful.

Distilled from pure grain. Combined with Botanicals from the four corners of the world. Blended with water from the beacons to create a clear spirit that is crisp, clean and exceptionally smooth.

name: Gordon's Lemon Meringue 35% Vol 70cl
description:
An iconic British twist on the original recipe from Alexander Gordon.

The classic taste of Gordon’s, perfectly balanced with zesty lemons and a delicate meringue sweetness. Made using only natural flavourings and colourings.

name: Whitley Neill Gin Japanese Yuzu & White Strawberry 70CL
description: Infused with zesty, fragrant citrus notes of Japanese Yuzu and succulent White Strawberries to create an exotic, bold gin.

name: Sipsmith London Dry Gin (Abv 41.6%)   70cl
description:
At Sipsmith we believe in uncompromisingly handcrafting our gin, and in celebration of becoming the first ever official gin partner of our equally uncompromising neighbour Wimbledon - home of The Championships, we've crafted a limited edition bottle* for our London Dry Gin for tennis and gin fans to cherish. Raise a toast to exquisite summer sipping!

*Please note, receiving the Sipsmith London Dry Gin 70cl bottle with the limited edition Wimbledon label is not guaranteed, you may instead receive the original bottle.

Sipsmith London Dry Gin is fresh, clean, and beautifully balanced with a sweet botanical bouquet complete with Juniper, baked lemon tarts, and white pepper.
Every drop is lovingly hand-crafted at London’s first copper-pot distillery for almost 200 years. We launched the craft gin boom in London – or, as we like to call it, the ginaissance – that has seen hundreds of small-batch gin distillers following in our intrepid footsteps.
Smooth enough for a Martini, yet rich and balanced, perfect for a G&T, Sipsmith London Dry Gin is a joy from first to last sip.

name: Ableforth's Bathtub Gin
description: Award-winning craft gin, double infused for extra flavour. Hand-crafted from start to finish: first we distilan already delicious London dry gin in a traditional copper-pot still, then we take our extra step. We cold infuse With juniper, coriander, cassia, cardamom, cloves and the very finest orange peel over a further seven days, tasting regularly to ensure that distinct Bathtub flavour we're proud of.

name: Engine Organic Italian Gin 500ml
description:
Engine is an Organic Italian gin produced in Piedmont, in Northern Italy. Engine Organic Gin is made using 100% Italian botanicals and has a stout structure but a kind soul. It sparkles on the rocks and shines in tonic water. Our aluminum cans are made out of recycled olive oil and motor oil cans. Further recycling of Engine Gin cans uses up to 90% less energy than recycling glass.

GT is the liquid acronym for Gin Tonic

Ingredients:
50ml of Engine Gin
100ml Tonic Water

Method: Pour all the ingredients directly into the ice-filled glass. The tonic water must be very cold! Garnish with a sage leaf.

42% Alc/Vol

name: Malibu Original White Rum with Coconut Flavour
description: Malibu Original White Rum with Coconut is the perfect drink for when the sun is setting and the good times are flowing. Thanks to its smooth, fresh taste, that sun-kissed island feeling is only a sip away. Malibu rum has a full and rounded, lightly toasted coconut aroma, and a creamy coconut taste with vanilla custard notes. The body is delicate with a soft warming rum taste and a lasting silky finish.

name: Bumbu Original Rum
flavour_style: soft caramel Madagascar vanilla toasted oak cinnamon roasted nuts allspice
description:
BUMBU: Dating back to the 16th century, when sailors of the West Indies added Caribbean fruits and spices to their rum, calling it "Bumbu". Flagship Original Bumbu is blended from fine Barbados rum and hand-selected spices that evoke its rich and colorful history, revealing heritage and craftsmanship with every sip.

CARIBBEAN RUM: An authentic Caribbean legend, Bumbu is an exquisite all-natural craft rum made with native ingredients and aged for up to 15 years to create an effortlessly smooth and balanced rum with complexity and depth. Bumbu uses the finest sugarcane from sustainable farms throughout the Caribbean and South America.

TASTING NOTES: On the nose, Bumbu offers complex aromas of soft caramel, Madagascar vanilla and toasted oak The palate is medium bodied with notes of cinnamon, roasted nuts and allspice, leading up to a slightly sweet, smooth finish.

name: Malibu Original White Rum with Coconut Liqueur
description: Malibu Original White Rum with Coconut is the perfect drink for when the sun is setting and the good times are flowing. Thanks to its smooth, fresh taste, that sun-kissed island feeling is only a sip away. Malibu rum has a full and rounded, lightly toasted coconut aroma, and a creamy coconut taste with vanilla custard notes. The body is delicate with a soft warming rum taste and a lasting silky finish.

name: Bacardi Carta Blanca Superior White Rum 1L
description: BACARDÍ Carta Blanca Superior white rum is aged in American white oak barrels and shaped through charcoal for a distinctive smoothness, making it perfect for classic rum cocktails. This light, aged rum offers a smooth and creamy taste.

name: Kraken Black Spiced Rum
description:
The Kraken is imported Caribbean rum blended with spices, caramel and other natural flavours.
Named for the sea beast of myth and legend, The Kraken is bold, rich, black and smooth.
The largest shipment of Caribbean black spiced rum was said to be brought down by the Kraken.
The rum was named in its honour, as it was as dark and mysterious as the beast's ink.
The Kraken is housed in a replica of a Victorian flagon, which allowed the bottle to be hung up on board ships so it would not roll around and come to harm.

Tasting Notes
Appearance - Black, opaque.
Aroma - Caramel, toffee, spice.
Flavour - Cinnamon, vanilla, nutmeg.
Finish - A spicy and lingering finish.

name: Captain Morgan Spiced Gold 0.0% Alcohol Free Spirit
description: Introducing Captain Morgan Spiced Gold 0.0% Alcohol Free Spirit. Enjoy an irresistible spiced flavour and smooth taste of Captain Morgan Original Spiced Gold, without the alcohol. Experience the versatility when it comes to mixing your favourite cocktails and enjoy the luscious notes of caramel, molasses, vanilla and warm brown spices. Best enjoyed mixed with cola in a glass with ice and lime for a smooth, refreshing taste.

name: The Kraken Black Cherry & Madagascan Vanilla Rum
description: A fruity and flavourful fusion of our signature Black Spiced Caribbean Rum with rich black cherries and an undercurrent of smooth Madagascan vanilla.

name: Dead Man's Finger Golden Spiced Rum 70CL
flavour_style: sweet creamy vanilla cinnamon and fresh lime
description:
This Golden Spiced is a blend of the finest rum with flavours including sweet creamy vanilla, cinnamon and fresh lime.
Enjoy it mixed with cola, lemonade or ginger beer. Either way, this is not your usual this is Cornish Soul.

name: Havana Club 7 Year Old Dark Rum
flavour_style: aromatic tobacco, sweet tropical fruits, molasses, spices, and vanilla
description:
Havana Club 7 Year Old perfectly demonstrates the versatility of high- quality Cuban rum, as well as the deep commitment and expertise of our Rum Masters with the complex ageing process.

Crafted for sipping, to be enjoyed on the rocks and ideal for rich cocktails: Havana Club 7 Year Old is highly versatile. This dark rum, matured in ex-Bourbon barrels, showcases the rich natural flavours of Cuba. The liquid unveils the tastes of the Cuban terroir: aromatic tobacco, sweet tropical fruits, molasses, spices, and vanilla from the continuous ageing process, enhanced by the slow release of aromas.

Packaging May Vary

name: Mount Gay Eclipse Barbados Golden Rum 70CL
flavour_style: fresh vanilla, almond, ripe banana and dark chocolate
description: Mount Gay Eclipse Barbados golden rum is distilled in traditional copper pot and column stills, then matured in ex-American whiskey casks. Eclipse is the embodiment of the Mount Gay style with notes of fresh vanilla, almond, ripe banana and dark chocolate, perfect for cocktails

name: Woods Old Navy Rum
flavour_style: smooth dark rum with punchy notes of brown sugar and thick toffee
description:
Wood's Navy Rum
Wood's Navy Rum is a traditional British naval style rum, still bottled at 57% and made to the original navy recipe from 1887. The spirit is made from Demerara molasses and contains three different rums, all distilled at the Diamond Distillery in Guyana, South America, before being shipped to the UK. One of these rums is distilled in the 250-year old Versailles still; the only single wooden pot still in the world. The spirits are then aged in Scotland in American refilled oak barrels for an average of 3 years, before being blended and made into Wood's Navy Rum.

Wood's is the only Demerara navy rum still bottled at 57% ABV, the original strength served on British Navy ships.
Made using traditional pot stills, it is a smooth dark rum with punchy notes of brown sugar and thick toffee.

name: Lamb's White Rum
description:
The hexagonal bottle of Lamb’s is vastly different from any other rum bottle across the globe.

Legend has it that Alfred used the same bottle shape we have today for his rum because it wouldn’t roll off the table on a ship and it could be stacked on its side for storage.

As you raise your glass, be transported to the heart of the high seas. Notes of vanilla and molasses dance upon your palate, while whispers of green banana and vanilla bean awaken your senses, leading to a clean, crisp finish that leaves you craving more.

Whether you're crafting a classic mojito or indulging in a tropical piña colada, Lamb’s White Rum is your faithful companion for any adventure.

name: Wray & Nephew Overproof White Rum
description:
Wray & Nephew White Overproof Rum is the original rum of the Jamaican people and it has been distilled and bottled there for nearly 200 years.
More than just a rum, it is an intrinsic part of Jamaican culture, tradition and everyday living, and in the UK it represents the proud, bold spirit of the island and its people.

Characterised by citrus, pear and pineapple notes with a long and spicy finish, it is a very versatile liquid.

name: Kraken Dark Caramel & Sea Salt Spiced Rum
flavour_style: toasted toffee aroma buttery vanilla finish
description:
Our signature Black Spiced Caribbean Rum infused with dark caramel and Cornish sea salt

A rich Infusion of Black Spiced Caribbean Rum, dark caramel and a hint of Cornish sea salt. Plunge into an alluring toasted toffee aroma and a buttery vanilla finish.

name: Havana Club Especial Cuban Rum 70cl
description: The natural ageing process in young oak barrels in Cuba for a number of years gives Havana Club Añejo Especial its warm amber colour and smooth taste. Aged in this way, it develops a typical touch of vanilla that is perfect for mixing with cola or just with ice. The best way to savour this special rum is in typical Cuban style - together with your best friends.

name: Lamb's Black Spiced Rum 70CL
description:
Lamb's Black Spiced Rum is a meticulously crafted, luxurious blend of flavours and aromas designed to captivate your senses.

With a rich coffee hue and hints of dark burgundy, this medium bodied rum offers a delightful sweetness and a harmonious palate of bakers cocoa, brown sugar, and allspice cake, with a long and lingering finish.

name: Admiral's Old J Cherry Spiced Rum
Jura Rum Cask Scotch Whisky
description:
Jura's Cask Editions range is the perfect introduction to our whisky, showcasing cask types from around the world that complement our fruity and balanced style.
Jura Caribbean Rum Cask is finished in select Caribbean rum casks for a smooth, creamy and fruity finish. With layers of tropical fruit, sweet citrus and a hint of vanilla spice.

name: Captain Morgan Spiced Gold Rum Based Spirit Drink   1L
description: The original. The icon. It's Captain Morgan Original Spiced Gold, a spiced rum-based spirit drink flavoured with the taste of vanilla, other natural flavours and spice for an irresistibly sweet yet subtly spiced taste. Versatility is its speciality. Make it hot, make it cold, make it sweet, make it fruity or even make it creamy. Delicious possibilities are there for the making.

name: Morrisons Caribbean Dark Rum
description: Rich, smooth Caribbean rums, blended for a fuller flavour.

name: Bacardi Spiced Premium Rum Spirit Drink
description: Made with aged rum and with a hint of smokiness from charred American oak barrels, BACARDÍ Spiced is a Gluten free rum blended with natural flavours and spices for a bold, yet smooth taste. BACARDÍ Spiced has both light and deep notes, making it perfect for mixing spiced rum drinks.

name: Absolut Blue Original Swedish Vodka 70CL
description:
Absolut Vodka is one of the worlds most famous vodkas. It is made exclusively from natural ingredients with winter wheat grown in the fields of Åhus, Sweden and absolutely no added sugar. Rich and full bodied, Absolut blends beautifully to enhance the taste of your favourite drinks and cocktails. This timeless vodka is the perfect gift to offer for a birthday present, or for anniversaries, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas and other special occasions.

Serving suggestion: Simply pour over ice, add soda or lemonade and garnish with lime or use in any of your favourite vodka cocktails.

name: J.J. Whitley Artisanal Vodka
flavour_style: warming spice and rich, smooth taste
description:
J.J Whitley Artisanal Russian Vodka is the result of the determination of one family to create a high quality, entirely unique Russian Vodka. A truly artisanal production process combines only the finest winter wheat with the crystalline water from the private well on the family's property. This ancestral approach to collective handcrafted, local produce results in an exceptional balanced vodka with warming spice and a rich, smooth taste.
Award-winning: International Wine & Spirit Competition 2020 - Gold (95 points)
San Francisco World Spirits Competition Gold Winner 2021
IWSC (International Wine & Spirits Competition) Gold Winner 2020
A sublimely smooth sipping vodka. A perfect accompaniment for your favourite mixer. An equally versatile cocktail hero ingredient. J.J Whitley Artisanal Russian Vodka is perfect for any occasion.

name: Absolut Raspberri Raspberry Flavoured Vodka 70CL
description: Absolut Raspberri Vodka is rich and intense with the fresh and fruity taste of ripened raspberries harvested in the Swedish hillsides. This raspberry flavoured vodka is made exclusively from natural ingredients, and unlike other flavoured vodkas, it doesn't contain any added sugar, making it perfect for mixing. It can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks or added to a wide selection of drinks and cocktails to enhance the taste.

name: Served Espresso Martini 125ml
description:
Rich, smooth, bitter-sweet.

Bar-quality Espresso Martini, full-strength at 14.9% ABV, made with SERVED Founders Reserve four-times distilled premium French vodka, cold brew coffee and coffee liqueur.

Shake, pour and serve.

100% Natural. Vegan. Gluten-free

name: Absolut Tabasco 700ml
description: ABSOLUT® and TABASCO join forces to deliver a spicy flavoured vodka that is the perfect balance of heat and flavour. Coming in hot is ABSOLUT® TABASCO™, a chili pepper flavoured vodka where each sip contains the distinct notes of aged Tabasco chili peppers and vinegar with an underlying sweetness. This delivers a bold and pleasant heat experience that engages all the senses, immediately inviting another sip. Together with vodka and tomato juice, TABASCO™ is considered one of the key ingredients in the creation of the Bloody Mary. Inevitably this was a perfect match waiting to happen – ABSOLUT® and TABASCO™ have joined forces to deliver a vodka that is the perfect balance of heat and inviting Tabasco chili pepper flavor. Mix ABSOLUT® TABASCO™ with tomato juice, Worcester sauce, lemon juice and a pinch of salt and pepper for the ultimate Spicy Bloody Mary. ABSOLUT® TABASCO™ is made with natural flavors and is produced and bottled in Åhus, Sweden. The main ingredients of ABSOLUT® TABASCO™ are winter wheat, and water sourced from local wells up to 176 m deep.

name: Smirnoff Mango & Passionfruit
description: Smirnoff Mango & Passionfruit Twist flavoured spirit is an exciting new taste sensation that expertly blends bold, tropical and fruity flavours. Made with exceptionally smooth Smirnoff No. 21 vodka, triple distilled from a blend of the finest grains and filtered ten times in a unique process through seven columns of charcoal. Smirnoff Mango & Passionfruit Twist is the perfect accompaniment for get togethers with friends and is best served with lemonade over ice and a slice of lime or mango wedge. Mix up delicious cocktails that everyone will love.

name: Smirnoff No. 21 Vodka Red Label 1L
description: Smirnoff No.21 - famously known as Red Label - is the world's favourite, most awarded and best-selling premium vodka. An exceptionally pure-tasting, smooth spirit with a clean palate, and the primary choice for a range of popular drinks. With countless years of heritage and unmatched quality, it is sold in over 130 countries. Founded in 1864, it gets triple distilled from a blend of different grains and filtered ten times through seven columns of environmentally sustainable charcoal for an exceptionally pure-tasting, smooth finish. Smirnoff No. 21 also makes a perfect aperitif such as the Espresso Martini - simply add 35ml Smirnoff, 25ml Espresso, 25ml coffee liquor, sugar syrup and cubed ice to a shaker and mix. Or if you prefer something more summery and refreshing, try 25 ml of Smirnoff, the citrus fruit juice of your choice, soda water, ice cubes in a highball glass and garnish with citrus fruit wedges. Smirnoff is ideal for making delicious drinks at home. As such a pure and versatile liquid, it is ideal for you to experiment and create your own cocktails. There is vodka, then there's Smirnoff.

name: Smirnoff Ice Triple Filtered Vodka Ready to Drink Premix
description: Smooth Smirnoff No. 21 premium vodka mixed with the classic taste of refreshing lemon. A delightfully crisp, citrus taste, best poured directly into a tall glass over cubed ice and garnished with a lemon wedge.

name: Smirnoff Ice Raspberry 4% vol Ready To Drink Premix
description: Smirnoff Ice Raspberry is a vodka mixed drink with the taste of Raspberries. Using Smirnoff No. 21 premium vodka, a blend of red raspberry flavours complemented by a dry, crisp finish. Lightly carbonated, this drink has a tangy kick with a refreshing taste.

name: Au Vodka Blue Raspberry Flavour
description:
Gold symbolising power and perfection represents the exceptional taste of our Au Blue Raspberry.
We have combined our award winning vodka with bursts of blueberry, raspberry and more! A unique fruit fusion creating a sweet and unique blue vodka.

name: Absolut Vanilia Vanilla Flavoured Swedish Vodka 70CL
description:
New bottle design and optimised liquid subject to availability.

Absolut Vanilia Vodka is perfect for those with a sweet tooth or those who like to experiment with contrasting flavours. It’s made exclusively from natural ingredients, and doesn't contain any added sugar. This rich, robust and complex vodka is characterised by it’s distinct taste of vanilla, notes of butterscotch and hints of dark chocolate. It can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks or added to a wide selection of drinks and cocktails to enhance the taste.

Serving suggestion: simply pour over ice, add cola and garnish with lime, or use it in any of your favourite vodka cocktails.

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin
description: A curious gin from Monkey 47, produced in Germany's Schwarzwald – also known as the Black Forest – and made with an impressive combination of no less than 47 botanicals. This medley of ingredients includes fruits and herbs that are native to the Black Forest, as well as exotic Asian botanicals, including elderberries, mint, almonds, jasmine, ginger, Vervain and camomile, to name a few. Understandably complex, the palate finds a delicate balance between notes of juniper, citrus, sweet flowers, bitter fruit and peppery spices that lends itself well to use in cocktails such as Martinis and Gimlets, as well as being mixed with tonic and garnished with a slice of orange.

name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin (41.3%)
description: A true classic, Tanqueray dry gin has been made with the same timeless recipe since 1830. With a solid juniper character, this textbook gin is a great all-rounder that works well in a Gin & Tonic and Martinis.

name: Hendrick's Gin
flavour_style: pink-tinged gin infused with rose petals and cucumber
description: A superb, and utterly unique, pink-tinged gin from William Grant's. Infused with rose petals and cucumber as well as the normal botanicals, this is a must for all gin-lovers.  In the summertime, Hendrick's makes a fantastically refreshing gin and tonic: serve in a tall glass with plenty of ice and garnish with thinly-sliced cucumber – delicious!

name: Xoriguer Gin Mahon
description: A cult gin from Mahon in Menorca, Xoriguer is one of the only gins in the world (alongside Plymouth) to have a geographical indication, Gin de Menorca. Gin has been made on Menorca since the 18th century British occupation and Xoriguer commands a devoted following of happy travellers. Unusually, Xoriguer is made in wood-fired pot stills from distilled wine (eau-de-vie) rather than the more usual grain-based distillate, and is rested in oak barrels before bottling.

name: Plymouth Gin
description: An elegant redesign of Plymouth, matching up their much respected and geographically protected gin with an old-school chunky bottle and their traditional branding. A must have for any home cocktail bar or lovers of a gin and tonic.

name: The Botanist Islay Dry Gin
description: An exciting and unusual gin from Islay whisky distillery Bruichladdich, The Botanist is made in a Lomond still christened Ugly Betty and contains no fewer than 31 botanicals, of which 22 are native to the Southern Hebridean island itself. The latter include the likes of mugwort, meadowsweet and the enigmatic Lady's Bedstraw flowers, and the resultant dry gin is described, perhaps unsurprisingly,  as 'floral'.

name: Papa Salt Coastal Gin
description: Made in Byron Bay, this gin combines native botanicals including wattleseed, pink peppercorn, and oyster shell with hibiscus, citrus peel, and wax flower. The result is a balanced gin with a subtle mineral edge.

name: Roku Noryo Tea Edition Gin
description: A limited-edition Japanese gin inspired by the noryo tradition of summer cooling, showcasing sencha and gyokuro green tea alongside Roku’s signature botanicals. Fresh and quietly complex, it layers grassy tea, soft citrus and delicate florals over a smooth, subtly umami palate, finishing clean with a gentle spice and cooling lift.

name: Ki No Bi Kyoto Dry Gin
description: Produced at Japan's Kyoto Distillery, Ki No Bi is the first gin to be made in the city. Made with a rice spirit and botanicals including yellow yuzu, Japanese cypress, green tea, bamboo and sanso berries (Japanese peppercorn), this has classic juniper notes which complement the Japanese botanicals. With a warming and spicy finish, this will make a delicious G&T.

name: Isle of Harris Gin
description: An aromatic Scottish gin from the Isle of Harris, part of the larger island of Lewis And Harris in the Outer Hebrides, and is made with a combination of nine botanicals, including hand-picked sugar kelp from local sea-lochs. The palate offers notes of juniper berries, bitter orange peel, coriander seed and liquorice root, as well as sweet-and-salty sugar kelp.

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin Gift Box
description: A curiously aromatic gin from Germany, Monkey 47 is made with a whopping 47 botanicals. These botanicals create a complex palate that lends itself well to simple, classic cocktails such as a Martini.

name: Capreolus Garden Swift Dry Gin Half Litre
description: Capreolus Garden Swift Dry Gin (formerly known as Garden Tiger) is made in Gloucestershire using an impressive 34 botanicals, of which most are secret. Two that are revealed are fresh Sicilian blood orange zest and lime-tree flowers. This incredibly complex gin can be enjoyed on its own, or in cocktails.

name: Oyster Fine de Claire Adriatic Gin
description: A premium Adriatic gin with classic juniper at its core, complemented by herbal and maritime botanicals for an elegant, balanced, and aromatic taste.

name: Fords London Dry Gin
description: Fords Gin is made at Thames Distillers in London using wheat. The botanicals – including Spanish lemon peel, Turkish grapefruit peel and Chinese jasmine – are steeped in the stills for 15 hours before distillation. The result is a gin where the botanicals come to the fore.

name: Hendrick's Orbium Gin
description: The distillers who brought us Hendrick’s beloved cucumber and rose gin have hit on another great innovation: quininated gin. By infusing their spirit with quinine and wormwood, Hendrick’s have created an complex and intriguing drink that pays homage to what is often mixed with gin: tonic and vermouth. The quinine and wormwood flavours are rounded out by blue lotus blossom, which adds bright floral notes to the mix.  Although it's delicious in tonic, you might also like to try Orbium with soda - which really lets the gin's flavour shine through - or in a classic cocktail such as a Martinez or Martini.

name: Personalised The Quintessential London Dry Gin
Sincere Pure Gin
description: Sincere Pure is an sugar-cane-based organic gin from Paraguay. Made using botanicals including angelica root, star anise, orris root, cloves, cinnamon, pink peppercorns, lemongrass and the indigenous congorosa, this is a rich and full-bodied spirit. All the ingredients are locally harvested, and the gin is sold in bottles made from 96% recycled glass.

name: Withers G1 Gin
description: The first gin released by Withers Gin, G1 is made with a combination of eight botanicals, including juniper, pink grapefruit zest and heartsease flower. Zesty, peppery and floral, try using this gin to create a refreshing G&T, garnish with a sprig of rosemary.

name: Tanqueray No.Ten Gin Litre
description: A super-premium small-batch Tanqueray named after the number of the No. 10 still in which it is made.  A superb controlled explosion of very aromatic botanical flavours, and it looks very good on your mantelpiece / drinks cabinet.

name: Edinburgh Gin The Classic
flavour_style: pine buds, lavender, lemongrass, mulberries and orange peel
description: This is a small-batch gin from Scotland that shows notes of pine buds, lavender, lemongrass, mulberries and orange peel. Try a measure of this in a Gin Fizz or a Gimlet.

name: Bude Cornish Dry Gin
description: The Cornish Distilling Company’s first foray into gin has been given a coastal Cornish twist. The region is known for its picturesque coast and boasts a vast array of aquatic plants that make great botanicals. This gin is made with a blend of nine botanicals including juniper, kelp, bladderwrack seaweed and grains of paradise which offer a saline minerality to your gin and tonics.

name: Gin Mare Capri Mediterranean Gin
description: In celebration of its 10th anniversary, Gin Mare has released a super-premium gin inspired by the iconic Italian island Capri. Made with a blend of botanicals including juniper, arbequina olive, basil, thyme and both lemon and bergamot from the Sorrento peninsula, Capri is aromatic and herbal with a lively vein of citrus throughout the palate.

name: Juniper Green Organic Gin
description: A London Dry Gin certified organic by the Soil Association, Juniper is something of a first.  The palate is light and elegant, with a gentle burst of spice at the finish.

name: Gin Del Professore Monsieur
flavour_style: richer with classic notes of juniper and citrus
description: The Del Professore range is a collaboration between Federico Ricatto, Carlos Quaglia and the Jerry Thomas Speakeasy in Rome. The Monsieur gin is the richer of the range, with classic notes of juniper and citrus.

name: Ron Zacapa Solera Gran Reserva Rum
flavour_style: caramel, vanilla, cocoa, dried fruit, honeyed sweetness, spices, molasses, smoke
description: A benchmark rum for many, Ron Zacapa is made from the first press of sugar cane and aged high in the Guatemalan mountains, where it benefits from cooler temperatures that slow maturation and deepen its character. Using the solera method, it combines spirits aged between six and 23 years to create consistent flavour. Expect aromas of caramel, vanilla, cocoa and dried fruit, followed by a palate of honeyed sweetness, spices and a long, velvety finish with hints of molasses and smoke.

name: The Scarlet Ibis 18 Year Old Rum The Whisky Exchange
flavour_style: lush, fruity rum with a heady nose. Sweet ripe banana, dark sugar, chocolate and soft spicing
description: The first ever rum bottled by The Whisky Exchange, this is an exquisite molasses-based distillate made and aged in Trinidad for something very special. 18 years maturing in the island’s tropical climate have resulted in a lush, fruity rum with a heady nose. Sweet ripe banana, dark sugar, chocolate and soft spicing all combine for a rum to remember.

name: Kraken Black Spiced Rum
flavour_style: rich, sticky rum infused with vanilla, caramel and an assortment of baking spices
description: Introduced to the UK in Spring 2010, Kraken is a dark spiced Caribbean rum that quickly gained popularity thanks to its vintage-style bottle and outstanding packaging. Inside, you'll find a rich, sticky rum infused with vanilla, caramel and an assortment of baking spices. Perfect for mixing into a Cuba Libre.

name: Foursquare Hereditas 14 Year Old Exclusive to The Whisky Exchange
description: Hereditas is a fruity, rich 14-year-old rum from Foursquare distillery in Barbados, bottled exclusively for The Whisky Exchange. Matured in a combination of bourbon and sherry casks, this is a bold tropical rum with notes of raisins, banoffee and stewed berries throughout the palate.

name: Isla N White Rum
description: A sweet, spicy single estate white rum made using fermented sugar cane from Tucuman in Argentina. The nose is sweet and smooth, with notes of vanilla, coconut, caramel and milk chocolate, building into richer coffee aromas. The palate opens with lighter notes of vanilla and caramel, before deepening with notes of spiced oak, peanut butter and toffee.

name: Stroh '80' Austrian Rum
flavour_style: rich notes of caramel burnt sugar and spices
description: Stroh 80 has been made in Klagenfurt, Austria since 1832 and built its reputation as a kitchen essential. Its power and flavour made it a key ingredient in traditional recipes like apple strudel and Sacher cake, especially for flambéing and enhancing desserts. The rum’s unique character comes from Caribbean molasses, which is imported and then blended and distilled locally. Expect rich notes of caramel, burnt sugar and spices.

name: Worthy Park 109 Rum
description: A field-to-glass Jamaican rum that has been distilled, aged, blended and bottled on the historic Worthy Park estate. Full-bodied and funky, this high-ester rum offers notes of tropical fruit, crystallised ginger and rich oak spice.

name: Pusser's Gunpowder Proof British Navy Rum
description: A classic British Navy style rum, Pusser's Gunpowder Proof rum has rich notes of treacle, toffee, honey and vanilla throughout the palate, alongside oak, cinnamon and ginger. Taking its name from the naval tradition of providing sailors a daily ration of rum, distributed by the Purser – or Pusser. The Pusser would dispel any complaints of watering down the rum by wetting a pinch of gunpowder with the rum and attempting to light it. If the mixture ignited it was "proof" that the rum was strong enough.

name: Hampden Estate 1753
description: A tribute to nearly three centuries of tradition, the Hampden Estate 1753 is named after the year the estate was founded. Balanced and approachable, it’s both authentic and accessible, the perfect entry point for people new to Jamaican rum or those wanting to explore Hampden’s house style.  A pure single Jamaican rum, it’s distilled on-site using local spring water, wild-yeast fermentation, and copper pot stills, with no added sugar or artificial colouring. It carries that funky, fruity, tropical character that Hampden Estate rum has become so renowned for: think ripe banana, pineapple, tropical fruit, sugar cane, herbal notes, and a touch of petrol and spice.  Drink it neat to fully appreciate all its vibrant aromatics or mix it into cocktails for added depth and character. Whether sipping or stirring, this high-ester rum delivers boldly and leaves a lasting impression.

name: Appleton Estate 12 Year Old Rare Casks
flavour_style: tropical fruit, hazelnuts, molasses, vanilla, coffee, orange zest
description: Appleton Estate’s Old Rare Casks was made by master blender Joy Spence from a blend of hand-picked pot and column still rums. Matured for at least 12 years in Jamaica, you can expect notes tropical fruit, hazelnuts and molasses, complemented by creamy vanilla, freshly ground coffee and bright orange zest.

name: Havana Club 3 Year Old Anejo Rum
description: This Cuban rum is aged for three years in white oak barrels, giving it a light straw colour. The nose offers woody aromas with hints of caramel, vanilla, and banana. Try this in classic cocktails like Mojitos and Daiquiris.

name: Mount Gay 25 Year Old Rum
flavour_style: rich vanilla, sweet caramel, zesty citrus, dark chocolate, tart cherry, raisins, toffee, cinnamon, toasted nuts, salt caramel, nutmeg, gingerbread
description: The world's oldest running rum distillery, Mount Gay, has launched the Exceptionally Aged Collection. Testament to generations of our Master Blenders and their skilled work, this 25 Year Old is an extremely rare chance to try a rum of such age and provenance.  Deep gold in the glass, the nose reveals rich vanilla, sweet caramel, zesty citrus, dark chocolate and an intriguing hint of tart cherry. The palate opens up further depth and complexity, with raisins and toffee balancing cinnamon and toasted nuts. A hint of salt caramel, nutmeg and gingerbread linger as the exquisitely long finish tapers off gracefully.

name: Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva Rum 2 Glasses Gift Set
description: A handsomely presented gift set with two Old Fashioned cocktail glasses accompanying a bottle of Venezuela's greatest export - the equally stunning and lip-smackingly tasty Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva.

name: Barcelo Imperial Maple Cask
flavour_style: caramel wild fig sandalwood sweet marasca cherry white pepper cinnamon
description: This release from Spanish rum producer Barcelo is part of its Rare Blends Collection. Its sugarcane juice rum is matured in a mix of casks, each toasted to varying levels before being finished in a maple wood cask. Imparting aromas of caramel, wild fig and sandalwood on the nose, leading to notes of sweet marasca cherry and drying to white pepper and cinnamon on the finish.

name: Santa Teresa 1796 Solera Speyside Whisky Cask Finish Rum
flavour_style: dark chocolate caramel almond and oak spice
description: This special release from Samnta Teresa uses the brand's solera process: casks of different aged rums are stacked vertically, the oldest (aged around 35 years) at the bottom, and as the distiller draws rum from one cask they top it up with younger liquid from the blend. It is then aged for up to 13 months in ex-Speyside whisky casks resulting in notes of dark chocolate, caramel, almond and oak spice.

name: El Dorado 12 Year Old
flavour_style: smoke, toffee, dark chocolate, stewed fruit, vanilla
description: This exceptional Demerara rum from El Dorado was aged for 12 years and comes inside a handsome gift box. A fantastic easy-going rum which was famously awarded the gold medal at the Caribbean Rum Taste Test for seven out of ten years. There is a subtle hint of smoke threaded through robust toffee-like flavours which lead to notes of dark chocolate, stewed fruit and hints of vanilla.

name: Hampden Estate 8 Year Old Rum
description: Intensely aromatic high-ester rum with distinctive notes of tropical fruit. This pot still rum is made at Hampden Estate using the same techniques the distillery has used since the 18th century. Matured for at least eight years in Jamaica’s tropical climate, it perfectly embodies the vibrant, complex style for which Hampden is famous. Expect overripe bananas, pineapples, green coffee beans and fruity dark chocolate on the nose – the benefits of a unique, extended fermentation – along with olives, allspice, seawater, engine oil and liquorice.   Totally unique, utterly idiosyncratic and easily one of the most characterful spirits being made today, it's a very deserving winner of our Rum of the Year 2024.

name: Mount Gay 15 Year Old Rum
flavour_style: ripe banana vanilla toasted almond caramel cinnamon butterscotch orange zest plum cocoa
description: Exclusively aged in ex-American Bourbon casks, the rum is dark gold. The inviting nose is prominent with ripe banana, vanilla, toasted almond, caramel and a touch of cinnamon to lead you in. The palate is smooth and harmonious, featuring butterscotch, vanilla and caramel. Those richer elements are balanced by hints of orange zest and plum, before deeper cocoa notes round out into a nuanced, flavourful finish.

name: Brugal 1888 Doblemente Anejado Rum Double Aged
description: This special edition from Dominican producer Brugal has been double-distilled and matured in American oak before a second maturation period in sherry casks to add a dose of dried fruit and leathery sweetness to the flavours.

name: Havana Club 11 Year Old Small Batch Exclusive to The Whisky Exchange
flavour_style: orange oil, stone fruit, floral honeys, sweet spices, almond
description: This exceptional bottling was created by Havana Club’s maestro del ron Cubano Asbel Morales, exclusively for The Whisky Exchange. Never before has this historic brand produced a special expression for a single retailer, so it is with great pride that we introduce this 11-year-old rum, distilled and aged in Cuba. Bottled at cask strength – another first for Havana Club – it shows excellent texture and concentration of flavour while retaining the classic elegance we expect from light, dry Cuban rum. You can anticipate notes of orange oil and stone fruit on the nose, while the palate brings floral honeys, sweet spices and hints of almond.

name: Diplomatico Reserva Exclusiva Rum
flavour_style: orange liquorice toffee caramel vanilla fudge
description: A blend of Venezuelan rums that have been aged for up to 12 years and specially-selected by Diplomatico's master blender. The palate offers notes of orange, liquorice, toffee, caramel and vanilla fudge that linger in the finish. Try using this rum to add a sweet, creamy backbone to your favourite cocktails, or simply enjoy it over ice.

name: Goslings Black Seal 151 Rum
description: An overproof version of Goslings' iconic Black Seal rum, famous the world over for having copyrighted the Dark 'N' Stormy cocktail.  151 refers to the strength in US proof, which equates to 75.5% alcohol by volume, so please use this one responsibly - ie very sparingly - and don't drink it neat.

name: Foursquare Spiced Rum
description: A delicious, high-quality spiced rum from Richard Seale's Foursquare distillery on Barbados, home of Doorly's.

name: El Dorado 15 Year Old Rum
description: El Dorado 15yo is a remarkable rum, whose greatest achievement was collecting the Wray & Nephew Trophy for Best Rum in the World at the International Wine & Spirits Challenge for an unprecedented four years running.

name: Ciroc Summer Citrus Vodka
flavour_style: blood orange tangerine lime zest lemon
description: A limited-edition Summer Citrus vodka from Ciroc that has aromas of blood orange and tangerine on the nose, complemented by notes of lime zest, blood orange and lemon throughout the palate.

name: Grey Goose Vodka
description: The iconic ultra-premium vodka, Grey Goose is a staple in bars and restaurants around the world. Born of a determination to create a French vodka unlike any other, it is made with the finest ingredients from the Cognac region of France. Delicate and fresh, with a creamy texture, Grey Goose is perfect for making your favourite cocktails, or simply enjoying over ice.

name: Belvedere Organic Vodka
description: A bottle of glorious quadruple-distilled rye vodka of extraordinary purity, Belvedere is as well known for its beautiful bottle as for its quality. A style-bar favourite.

name: Reyka Vodka
description: Reyka is a small batch vodka produced in Iceland using a process that includes the filtration through lava rock.  Made in one of only six carter head stills in the world, this is made from a mixture of wheat and barley.

name: Svitlo Vodka of Ukraine Litre
description: A creamy, well-balanced corn vodka from the Cherasky region of central Ukraine. This is a great choice for your next Martini or Bloody Mary, but it will also really shine served well-chilled with pickles and smoke meat or fish. Every bottle of Svitlo sold helps to support creative industries in Ukraine, a cause well worth raising a glass to.

name: Utkins UK5 Organic Vodka
description: Utkins UK5 organic vodka is made using organic barley and pure British water to create a crisp and great tasting spirit. The producers have held a royal warrant since 2007, appointed by King Charles while he was Prince of Wales, and continued now that he is king.

name: Black Cow Vodka
description: Black Cow was the world's first vodka to be made entirely from milk. Made in West Dorset, in the proximity of Bridport, the milk is separated in curds and whey. The curds are used to make cheese, of which one is Barber's 1833 Cheddar, which won the 2012 World Cheese Awards Cheddar Trophy. The whey is then fermented and distilled to make the vodka. The texture is, somewhat unsurprisingly, rather creamy.

name: Pau Maui Vodka
description: This crisp vodka is made at Hali’imaile distillery in Makawao, Hawaii. In addition to producing vodka, the distillery also makes gin, rum and whiskey. Pau Maui vodka is designed to work well in an array of classic cocktails but shines when mixed with juicy pineapples – the original Hawaiian treat.

name: Beluga Noble Vodka
description: A bottle of Beluga's excellent vodka, distilled in Latvia and bottled in Montenegro. Clean and crisp with just a hint of grainy flavour.  Made with malted barley as a base, this is lightly flavoured with honey, oak and milk thistle.

name: Konik's Tail Vodka
description: Launched in 2010, Konik's Tail is named after the wild ponies of Poland's primeval forest, and is crafted from three distinct grains – spelt, rye and early winter wheat, represented by the three koniks on the label. Konik's Tail has been a huge hit in style bars.

name: Zubrowka Biala Winter Rye
description: The non-flavoured version of famous Polish brand Zubrowka, made from winter rye. With the classic creamy texture, this will work well chilled on its own or in a variety of mixed drinks.

name: Chopin Potato Vodka
description: A superb-quality Polish potato vodka, distilled four times – it takes approximately five kilos of potatoes to make each bottle.  Chopin is a long-time favourite in style bars and has an enviable reputation as one of the finest vodkas available.

name: Zubrowka Bisongrass Vodka
description: Zubrowka is one of the best Polish vodkas available, flavoured with a special kind of aromatic bisongrass that is so prized that it costs £400 per kilo. Long renowned for its luxurious flavours and stellar quality, Zubrowka is simply outstanding with apple juice, especially the posh cloudy stuff.

name: Crystal Head Aurora Vodka
description: A 2015 limited-edition extension to Dan Aykroyd's Crystal Head range, this is named after the natural light phenomenon, Aurora Borealis. Made with English wheat and Canadian water, this is five-times distilled and seven-times filtered. Drier, bolder and spicier than the original.

name: Kavka Vodka
description: A classically-styled Polish vodka, made in the west of the country in a distillery that has been making spirit for more than 200 years. Master distiller Urzula Wojcik has turned back the clock to the 18th and 19th century and used plum and apple in addition to rye and wheat to create a vodka with real character and, unlike many, taste. It's a crisp and clean vodka, but with gentle fruitiness – excellent in a Martini.

name: Smirnoff Black Label Vodka
description: This premium variant of Smirnoff is pot-distilled and filtered through seven tons of charcoal in a painstaking production process designed to produce a vodka of rare purity.

name: Potocki Vodka
description: A terrific rye vodka, distilled just twice and bottled without charcoal filtration to retain its full-flavoured nuttiness.  Potocki is one of the best Polish vodkas on the market.

name: Ammos Aegean Vodka
flavour_style: bright citrus notes subtle saline depth layered refreshing character
description: Premium Greek-inspired craft vodka infused with the essence of the Aegean. Bright citrus notes from Vakhalou lemons meet a subtle saline depth from dry-cured olives, creating a layered, refreshing character. Cold-distilled to preserve its delicate flavours, it’s perfect neat, chilled, or in elevated cocktails.

name: Belvedere Vodka Gift Box
description: Belvedere is a glorious quadruple-distilled rye vodka of extraordinary purity, well known for its beautiful bottle as for its quality. As always with vodka, this is all about its character, rather than its flavour, and makes a great base for a Vodka Martini or Vesper. This favourite of cocktail bars, nightclubs and home drinks cabinets alike comes beautifully packaged in a great gift box.

name: Tito's Vodka
description: Tito's Vodka hails from Texas' first and oldest legal distillery in Austin.  The brainchild of former geologist Tito Beveridge, this is six times distilled.

name: Jewel Lines Precious Vodka Sapphire
description: Jewel Lines' Precious Vodka is distilled six times in Bulgaria. Each bottle includes a real sapphire and would make an extra-luxurious gift.

name: Wyborowa Vodka
description: This is a popular rye-based vodka from Poland with history dating back to 1927. This works brilliantly in classic cocktails and helps other flavours shine whilst adding a creamy texture and subtle spice.

name: Bimber Blackcurrant Infused Vodka
flavour_style: warming fruity vodka with notes of honey, clove, cinnamon and vanilla
description: Made in west London, this is a blend of quadruple-distilled wheat vodka and real blackcurrants – half a kilo per bottle. A warming fruity vodka with notes of honey, clove, cinnamon and vanilla.

name: Ciroc Limonata Vodka
description: Ciroc produces a wonderful range of flavoured vodkas which includes this Limonata Vodka. Made from an infusion of citrus and Italian lemon flavours, this is a zesty and zippy vodka, perfect in a spritz or Cosmopolitan.
